ann_81.text: Through this part, being in California or Washington rather than West Virginia raises the typical customer's predicted chance of leaving to about 12% and 9% (on the training data only).

Maine and New Jersey slightly raise it to about 7%, Michigan, Texas and Tennessee to about 6% and twelve other groups of states to about 4% to 5%, while Hawaii and Vermont slightly lower it to about 1% and Colorado, Virginia, Illinois, Georgia, Missouri, Alabama, Pennsylvania and Nebraska to about 2% to 3% (on the training data only).
